definitions.explanation: A tall, pointed tower on a building, especially a church or mosque. Also used for any tall, tapering architectural structure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{尖塔|せんとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伸|の}びている→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: The church spire stretches toward the sky.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}く⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{尖塔|せんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先端|せんたん}→先端：04370_sentan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: I could see the tip of the steeple from far away.

examples.japanese: ゴシック⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大聖堂|だいせいどう}→大聖堂：20731_daiseidou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{尖塔|せんとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧だ。
examples.english: Gothic cathedrals are characterized by their tall spires.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in architecture, travel writing, and descriptions of Western buildings. A compound of {尖|せん} (pointed) and ⟦{塔|とう}→塔：09944_tou⟧ (tower).

NOTE: This is a homophone of ⟦{先頭|せんとう}→先頭：04374_sentou⟧ (the lead, the front), ⟦{戦闘|せんとう}→戦闘：12639_sentou⟧ (battle), and ⟦{銭湯|せんとう}→銭湯：16032_sentou⟧ (public bath).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{尖塔|せんとう} (church steeple)
- {尖塔|せんとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦そびえる→そびえる：10360_sobieru⟧ (a spire towers up)
- ゴシック⟦{様式|ようしき}→様式：05455_youshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{尖塔|せんとう} (Gothic-style spire)
